items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Yank came, and we -- he was a pretty good drummer, see. So anyway, Yank played in the band. We went on tour.

ctx.x: Yank was in New York. I think he had -- he was with the second -- with the -- one of the revived Black Birds show, and so Pop sent for Yank to join the band in New York, and Yank came, and we -- he was a pretty good drummer, see. So anyway, Yank played in the band. We went on tour.

And one of the places -- I never will forget -- we went to San Antonio, Texas, and we played at a roadhouse out there. Well, it wasn't quite called roadhouses then. I think they were called like caberets, but it was still out -- out on the outskirts of town. And we were all staying, naturally, in the black neighborhood, so we were all sitting out on the porch one day, talking, and you know, just killing time, and a white fellow walked up to us and he says, "I found out where you guys live. I just wanted to come…
